features.title: Powerful Features

encryption.title: Military-Grade Encryption
encryption.description: AES-256-GCM encryption standard ensures your data is protected with the highest level of security.

autodestruct.title: Configurable Auto-Destruction
autodestruct.description: Choose your security level: enable auto-destruction (1-10 attempts) or disable it for unlimited tries. NEW in v1.1!

hidden.title: Hidden Folders
hidden.description: Encrypted folders are completely hidden from Windows Explorer with HIDDEN + SYSTEM attributes.

multilang.title: Responsive Interface
multilang.description: Adaptive UI that adjusts to your screen size. Strong password requirements ensure maximum security. NEW in v1.1!

modular.title: Modular Architecture
modular.description: Clean, maintainable code following Screaming Architecture principles for easy extensibility.

opensource.title: Open Source
opensource.description: Fully transparent and auditable code. No backdoors, no hidden surprises.

security.title: Bank-Level Security
security.subtitle: Your data deserves the best protection
features: Unique salt per folder for maximum security
Strong password requirements (8+ chars, A-Z, a-z, 0-9, symbols)
Responsive interface adapts to any screen size

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple steps to secure your data

1.title: Configure Security
1.description: Create a strong master password (8+ chars with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols). Choose auto-destruction settings.

2.title: Add Folders
2.description: Select folders you want to encrypt. Give them custom names and encrypt with a single click.

3.title: Stay Secure
3.description: Your folders are now encrypted and hidden. Decrypt them anytime with your master password.

executable.description: Ready to use, no installation required
